n1a218f324e.headline: 21st Austria weekly - ATX TR at 8829.84 - a loss of 9,35 percent last week  (05/04/2025)
n1a218f324e.summary: The ATX total return index closed at 8,829.84, a loss of 9.35% over the week. The report covers the week ending April 5, 2025.
n1a218f324e.why: The ATX is Vienna's main benchmark index, tracking the largest companies listed on the Vienna Stock Exchange.
n1a218f324e.why_moved: The weekly loss came during a broader global sell-off driven by US tariff concerns, as other reports in the same period describe.

n492db4b8e8.headline: For these seniors, DOGE's affordable housing pause means suffering longer without AC
n492db4b8e8.summary: The Trump administration froze funding for a program that upgrades aging low-income housing to make it energy efficient. The move threatens hundreds of projects around the country.
n492db4b8e8.why: Federal housing and energy-efficiency programs affect construction activity and the contractors and utilities involved in them.

nb915d9a226.headline: 'One of the Most Ambitious Projects' Heads to Pennsylvania
nb915d9a226.summary: An AI data-center campus will be built on the site of Pennsylvania's largest coal plant, described as one of the state's most ambitious projects. The article gives no further details on investors or timing.
nb915d9a226.why: Large AI data-center projects drive demand for power and computing hardware, and their energy sourcing is a growing concern for utilities and investors.

ne0fb93cbb0.headline: Trump’s Tariffs Threaten to Spark a Global Trade War
ne0fb93cbb0.summary: Projections cited in the article suggest US tariffs under Trump could significantly affect economies worldwide. Poland and Thailand are estimating GDP losses, with countries including India and Germany also cited.
ne0fb93cbb0.why: Tariffs can reduce export demand and raise costs, and projected GDP losses across major economies matter for global growth forecasts and emerging-market assets.

n3b3187e7f2.headline: Spain: Tens of thousands protest nationwide housing crisis
n3b3187e7f2.summary: Tens of thousands of people protested in 40 Spanish cities on Saturday against housing speculation. Demonstrators demanded housing as a right.
n3b3187e7f2.why: Housing affordability and speculation affect property markets, household finances and government housing policy.

neea87d4539.headline: Despite Trump’s Crackdown, Venezuela Still Has Buyers
neea87d4539.summary: Dozens of tankers are still arriving or mooring near Venezuelan terminals at José, Amuay and Puerto La Cruz, even as US presidential decisions have affected who buys its oil.
neea87d4539.why: Venezuela holds some of the world's largest proven crude reserves, and its export buyers determine flows into global oil markets.

n8aaf10c5c3.headline: PM Anwar assures Malaysians the country won't slip into recession following US tariffs
n8aaf10c5c3.summary: Prime Minister Anwar Ibrahim assured Malaysians the country will not slip into recession for now after US tariffs, saying the economy remains resilient.
n8aaf10c5c3.why: Malaysia is a trade-exposed Southeast Asian economy, so US tariff policy affects its exports and growth outlook.

n5ce570c13b.headline: Wall Street braces as US stock futures tumble
n5ce570c13b.summary: US stock futures opened lower, suggesting a possible resumption of a dramatic selloff that wiped trillions of dollars from stock markets.
n5ce570c13b.why: US stock futures are contracts that signal expected opening moves in major indexes such as the S&P 500, making them a closely watched gauge of near-term market sentiment.
n5ce570c13b.why_moved: Futures opened lower after a selloff that had already wiped trillions of dollars from stock values, signalling continued selling pressure at the open.

n4938118b4d.headline: UK PM ready to 'shelter' businesses from tariff storm
n4938118b4d.summary: UK Prime Minister said he is ready to shelter businesses from the tariff storm as Trump's tariffs begin. Jaguar Land Rover has suspended shipments of its cars to the US.
n4938118b4d.why: Jaguar Land Rover is a major UK car exporter owned by India's Tata Motors, and US tariffs on imported vehicles affect its margins and exports. Government support can influence sector resilience.

n37532252e6.headline: Aussie dollar slumps below 60 US cents for first time since COVID
n37532252e6.summary: The Australian dollar posted its biggest fall since 2008 and dropped below 60 US cents, a level last seen in early 2003 according to the report.
n37532252e6.why: The Australian dollar is a major commodity-linked currency, so its moves affect exporters, importers and returns on Australian assets for foreign investors.

impacts.name: Australian dollar
impacts.why: The report states the Australian dollar fell below 60 US cents, a direct move in the currency pair.
impacts.baseline_rule: first recorded price at or after created_at (15-minute price recorder); end = first price at least 24 h later, within 48 h

n37532252e6.why_moved: The currency recorded its biggest fall since 2008, according to the report, pushing it to levels not seen since early 2003.

nd3cf9f6390.headline: Trump's new tariff to affect basmati rice export from Punjab, likely to benefit Pakistan
nd3cf9f6390.summary: A 26 percent US tariff imposed by President Donald Trump will directly hit basmati rice exports from India, mainly from Punjab. Pakistan is likely to benefit.
nd3cf9f6390.why: Basmati rice is a major agricultural export for India and Pakistan, and US import tariffs change their relative competitiveness in that market.

n188191f8fe.headline: U.S. stocks are volatile as selloffs sweep through global markets
n188191f8fe.summary: Shares fell around the world on Monday as higher US tariffs and a backlash from Beijing triggered sharp sell-offs. Trump defended the tariffs, saying you have to take medicine to fix something.
n188191f8fe.why: US equities are the largest and most liquid stock market globally, so their swings set the tone for world markets. Tariff-driven volatility often hits multinational earnings expectations.
n188191f8fe.why_moved: Higher US tariffs and a backlash from Beijing triggered sell-offs across global markets, according to the report. Trade-war fears raise expectations of weaker trade and earnings.

nb6d9ff9f1e.headline: Rise in national insurance to hit jobs and investment, high street bosses warn
nb6d9ff9f1e.summary: Business leaders warn that the rise in employer national insurance contributions, from 13.8% to 15%, will hit jobs and investment. The increase takes effect on Sunday, April 6.
nb6d9ff9f1e.why: Employer National Insurance is a payroll tax that raises the cost of hiring for UK companies, so changes feed directly into labour costs and margins.

nbe733a1014.headline: UK national insurance hike is inexplicable if growth is target, says Robison
nbe733a1014.summary: Scotland's Finance Secretary said the UK national insurance increase was inexplicable if growth is the target, arguing it was bad for both business and public services.
nbe733a1014.why: National insurance is a payroll tax that affects employer costs and take-home pay, which shapes business hiring and consumer spending.

n0a630708ab.headline: Silver lining to US tariff
n0a630708ab.summary: Trade groups in Petaling Jaya say the US tariffs are not all doom and gloom and carry a silver lining for Malaysia.
n0a630708ab.why: Malaysia is a trading economy, so shifts in US tariffs can redirect trade and investment flows in the region.

n118fa111f2.headline: U.S. stocks are volatile as selloffs sweep through global markets
n118fa111f2.summary: Shares fell around the world on Monday as higher US tariffs and a backlash from Beijing triggered sharp sell-offs. President Trump defended the tariffs, saying the country must take medicine to fix problems.
n118fa111f2.why: US equities represent the largest share of global stock market capitalisation, so tariff-driven volatility spreads quickly to international portfolios.

source.name: NPR News and Music for northeast Louisiana | KEDM

sources.name: NPR News and Music for northeast Louisiana | KEDM

n118fa111f2.why_moved: Higher US tariffs and a backlash from Beijing triggered sell-offs in shares around the world on Monday.

nba5a0bb42b.headline: China electronics casts neighbourly eye on India
nba5a0bb42b.summary: Chinese companies have found it tough to get investment proposals approved in India since bilateral ties sharply worsened after a 2020 border skirmish. US tariffs are also shaping the electronics sector.
nba5a0bb42b.why: India is a fast-growing electronics manufacturing hub, and rules on Chinese investment shape supply chain decisions for global device makers.

n4de713e555.headline: Globalisation has come to an end, says minister
n4de713e555.summary: Chief Secretary to the Treasury Darren Jones said Britain needs to build relationships with allies and partners around the world.
n4de713e555.why: The Chief Secretary to the Treasury is a senior UK finance minister, and official views on trade strategy shape the economic policy outlook.

nfc35a08d10.headline: Finance minister rules out wage subsidy scheme for firms affected by tariffs - Main Topics - Laois Nationalist
nfc35a08d10.summary: Ireland's finance minister has ruled out a wage subsidy scheme for firms affected by the 20 per cent US tariffs. Ministers and businesses are grappling with the impact of the tariffs.
nfc35a08d10.why: Government support measures for exporters affect corporate earnings and employment in Irish firms exposed to US trade.

n380fdac9be.headline: Media Minister Patrick O’Donovan to block ‘Netflix levy’ plan - Entertainment - Laois Nationalist
n380fdac9be.summary: Media Minister Patrick O'Donovan is set to block a plan for a Netflix levy. The proceeds had been intended to fund independent productions in Ireland.
n380fdac9be.why: Levies on streaming platforms affect the economics of global streamers operating in Ireland and the funding of domestic production.

n2525c3758e.headline: Finance minister rules out wage subsidy scheme for firms affected by tariffs - Main Topics - Kildare Nationalist
n2525c3758e.summary: Ireland's finance minister ruled out a wage subsidy scheme for firms affected by the 20% US tariffs. Ministers and businesses are grappling with the impact of the tariffs.
n2525c3758e.why: Irish fiscal policy affects support for exporters and employers exposed to US trade measures.

ne7742ee1a6.headline: QIAGEN N.V.:  QIAGEN announces strong preliminary Q1 2025 results and updates full-year 2025 adjusted earnings per share outlook
ne7742ee1a6.summary: QIAGEN announced strong preliminary first-quarter 2025 results and updated its full-year 2025 adjusted earnings per share outlook. The announcement was published on April 6, 2025.
ne7742ee1a6.why: QIAGEN is a Dutch-registered life sciences company that supplies sample preparation and molecular testing products to labs and hospitals.
ne7742ee1a6.why_moved: QIAGEN reported strong preliminary Q1 results and updated its full-year adjusted EPS outlook.

nee688cb983.headline: Federal leaders pledge red tape cuts, skilled trades support and family doctors
nee688cb983.summary: Conservative and Liberal leaders are promising measures to bolster Canada's economy amid the trade war with the US, including red tape cuts, skilled trades support and family doctors.
nee688cb983.why: Canada's economy is heavily tied to US trade, so federal economic policy and election pledges shape business investment and fiscal outlook.

na7474278a3.headline: Canada’s energy industry faces ‘maelstrom’ of uncertain global economy  | Globalnews.ca
na7474278a3.summary: After a week of economic turmoil, Canada's energy industry and the governments that rely on it for revenue will be watching markets closely in the coming days, according to Global News.
na7474278a3.why: Canada's energy sector is a major export earner and a large source of government revenue, so market swings feed directly into its finances.

nb445c472bf.headline: Andhra CM urges Centre to come to rescue of aqua sector hit by US tariff
nb445c472bf.summary: Chief Minister Naidu urged the central government to support the aquaculture sector, which is in deep crisis due to heavy US duties. He made the appeal on Sunday.
nb445c472bf.why: Shrimp and aquaculture exports are a major income source for Andhra Pradesh, and US duties hit a key export market. Government support can affect farmers and processors.

na0b7e10e0c.headline: Federal leaders pledge red tape cuts, skilled trades support and family doctors
na0b7e10e0c.summary: Conservative and Liberal leaders are promising measures to bolster Canada's economy amid the trade war with the US, including red tape cuts and skilled trades support. The NDP pledged family doctor access.
na0b7e10e0c.why: Canada's federal policy on trade, regulation and skilled labour shapes business investment and the economic outlook for exporters. Trade tensions with the US are central to that outlook.

n0c95b15660.headline: Carney, Starmer discuss deeper trade ties in response to Trump's tariff war
n0c95b15660.summary: Canadian Prime Minister Mark Carney spoke with UK Prime Minister Keir Starmer about the fallout from the United States' global tariff campaign and deeper trade ties.
n0c95b15660.why: Canada and the UK are major trading partners, and tariff disputes affect their cross-border trade and investment.

n5ed8a13fdf.headline: Cheap batteries pledge powers Labor re-election push
n5ed8a13fdf.summary: The Australian Labor Party pledges to cut energy costs by reducing green taxes, aiming to support consumers and businesses.
n5ed8a13fdf.why: Green taxes influence energy prices and competitiveness, affecting economic activity and market sentiment.
